name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: UnieAI Agent desktop shell: an Electron window over a harness this app starts and owns

scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never
